title: fix(plugin-form): every object-form layout locks a managed object's fields, through one gate with field-level security (objectui#10612)
body:
Fixes #10612
Clause-②: no — five form layouts begin honouring the managed-object lock the default layout already applies; no export, schema or accept set moves.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM loop, claim comment `5834057903`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (subagent run). Folds in objectui#10613 (the ADR-0092 D4 half), per triage `5833552948`.

## What changed

One field-gate step, `gateFormFields` in `packages/plugin-form/src/fieldWriteGate.ts`, now does both gates in one pass:

1. field-level security, through the existing `applyFieldPermissions` (drop what the caller may not read, lock what they may read but not write);
2. the ADR-0092 D4 managed-object lock, through `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances`: every drawn field is `disabled` when the object's affordance for the form's mode is off. The inputs are the `managedBy` bucket, the `userActions` opt-in, and the server's effective API operations (the objectui#3546 intersection).

Every layout calls that one step on the fields it has resolved: the default arm (`SimpleObjectForm`, flat and sectioned), `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm` (sections, derived field groups, flat), and `TabbedForm`, `SplitForm` and `WizardForm` (sections). The default arm's field generator no longer stamps the lock itself. Its `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances` block moved into the gate unchanged: same modes, same intersection, `disabled` only.

H3, the lock's effect, matches the default arm exactly. It sets `disabled` only (no `readOnly`) and adds no message. The submit button stays on screen on every layout, as it always did on the default arm; the server's write guard refuses the save.

One deliberate consequence, called out in the changeset with ⚠️: the lock now runs after resolution, so on the default arm an inline `customFields` member, and a section entry already written as a full field definition, are locked with the rest. Before, the generator stamped only the fields it generated, so these two escaped. That is the "one step with FLS" the triage ruled, and it matches the lock's own comment ("disable every field"). The `managed, inline member (create)` row pins it.

`MasterDetailForm` is not one of the six arms. Its header renders through `ObjectForm` (simple or `tabbed`), so it takes this gate.

## H1: the six arms on base `f99f9cde7`

Measured by the new table, run against base sources (see the red/green section). "Locked" means the field kept no enabled control.

| layout | read-denied `amount` | managed, no `userActions.create` (create) | managed, no `userActions.edit` (edit) | server denies `create` | managed + inline member |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| simple (sections, flat) | dropped | locked | locked | locked | member **live** |
| drawer (sections, flat) | dropped | **live** | **live** | **live** | **live** |
| modal (sections, flat) | dropped | **live** | **live** | **live** | **live** |
| tabbed | dropped | **live** | **live** | **live** | **live** |
| split | dropped | **live** | **live** | **live** | **live** |
| wizard | dropped | **live** | **live** | **live** | **live** |

Submit, per arm: on base and on head alike, every arm offers an enabled submit (`Create` in create mode, `Update` in edit mode, next to `Cancel`). This change does not touch the submit. Scratch probe (never committed) on `better-auth` with no opt-in, create and edit:

| arm | base fields | head fields | submit (base = head) |
|---|---|---|---|
| simple | locked, locked | locked, locked | `Create` / `Update`, enabled |
| drawer | editable, editable | locked, locked | `Create` / `Update`, enabled |
| modal | editable, editable | locked, locked | `Create` / `Update`, enabled |
| tabbed | editable, editable | locked, locked | `Create` / `Update`, enabled |
| split | editable, editable | locked, locked | `Create` / `Update`, enabled |
| wizard | editable, editable | locked, locked | `Create` / `Update`, enabled |

## Pins, red on base and green on head

`packages/plugin-form/src/formArmsFieldGate-10612.test.tsx`: 9 layouts (six arms with sections, plus the flat path of the default, drawer and modal arms) × 6 rows. Each row asserts the exact drawn field set and the locked state of each field. The rows are read-denied field, managed create, managed edit, server denies create, managed with an inline member, and a lit control (`userActions.create: true` draws everything live). In sections `amount` is a spec entry carrying `readonly: false`, so the rows also show that no entry override lifts either lock.

- Head `8e9248007`: this file together with `sectionEntryOverrides-10475`, `ObjectForm.managedEdit`, `ObjectForm.effectiveOps` and `formArmsWritePayload-10563` gives `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 123 passed (123)`.
- Base sources (the 8 changed `src` files checked out at `f99f9cde7`, blob hashes verified, then restored from `HEAD` and proven by blob equality and an empty `git diff HEAD`): `Tests 30 failed | 50 passed (80)` over this file and the 10475 file. The 30 are the 4 lock rows × 7 non-default layouts (28), plus the inline-member row on both default-arm layouts (2). The read-denied row and the control are green on base on all 9 layouts: the FLS half landed with objectui#10626, so those rows are regression pins. All 26 rows of `sectionEntryOverrides-10475.test.tsx` are green on base as well, including the reworked pool-base row.

## Per-arm ablation

Each leg ran through `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. It swaps that arm alone to `applyFieldPermissions as gateFormFields`, which keeps FLS and drops the lock. The anchor hit exactly once, and the blob changed on disk. After the run, the restore was proven: blob equal to `HEAD`, empty `git diff HEAD`.

| arm ablated | failed / 54 | failing layouts × rows |
|---|---|---|
| default (`ObjectForm.tsx`) | 8 | simple sections + simple flat × the 4 lock rows |
| `DrawerForm.tsx` | 8 | drawer sections + drawer flat × the 4 lock rows |
| `ModalForm.tsx` | 8 | modal sections + modal flat × the 4 lock rows |
| `TabbedForm.tsx` | 4 | tabbed × the 4 lock rows |
| `SplitForm.tsx` | 4 | split × the 4 lock rows |
| `WizardForm.tsx` | 4 | wizard × the 4 lock rows |

In every leg the read-denied row and the control stay green, and every other layout stays green. So each arm's rows depend on that arm's own call, and on nothing shared that a single layout could stand in for.

## Also changed

- `sectionEntryOverrides-10475.test.tsx`, row "the POOLED field is the base". It used the managed lock as its pool-only fact, and that lock no longer rides the pool, so the row could no longer fail for its stated reason. It now uses the numeric `step` the default arm's generator writes and `fromObjectSchema` does not: `0.01` on the default arm, and no `step` attribute on the drawer as the no-pool control.
- `sectionFields.ts`, the `SectionFieldsContext.pool` doc: it no longer lists the managed-object lock among the pool's per-field facts.
- `.changeset/10475-default-arm-section-builder.md`: its sentence "the form's own field definition remains the starting point for an override, so an override does not lift a managed object's field lock" is now scoped "at this change". It gains a dated note (2026-09-25, objectui#10612) saying the lock now applies after the override on every layout. Frontmatter md5 is `21fc281303c02040481bc4b368c13334` before and after.
- README (`What an edit save writes`) and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` each gain one sentence: every layout disables a managed object's fields when its `userActions` do not open the mode.
- New changeset `.changeset/10612-form-arms-managed-lock.md` (`'@object-ui/plugin-form': patch`).
